verses.1: Praise the LORD! Call upon His name. Let people everywhere know of His greatness.
verses.2: Sing to him, chant praises to him; praise him in all his wonders.
verses.3: They praised in His holy name; He will rejoice those who seek Him.
verses.4: He will demand it from them, and their faces will always be turned towards Him.
verses.5: Remember his miracles that he performed, and the judgments of his mouth.
verses.6: The seed of Abraham became servants to the sons of Jacob through their choice.
verses.7: He is Jehovah our God, who judges over all the earth.
verses.8: He remembered his covenant forever; his words were commanded for thousands of generations.
verses.9: Who has killed Abraham and made his death a source of ridicule.
verses.10: And she stood before Jacob to be a bond of peace between Israel and the nations forever.
verses.11: And he said to you, “I will give you the land of Canaan as a possession.”
verses.12: They were living in small groups and lived there.
verses.13: And they went from one country to another, from one king to another.
verses.14: Man did not allow them to be tortured or treated cruelly by kings.
verses.15: Do not offend my Messiah and my Prophets. Do not rebel against them.
verses.16: And hunger came upon the earth; every grain of bread was destroyed.
verses.17: He sent someone before them to serve as a slave. Yosef.
verses.18: He hung his feet on the iron chains; his soul was taken away.
verses.19: Until it came to pass, Jehovah said, “Exile him.”
verses.20: The king sent someone to free him from the control of the nations. And he was freed.
verses.21: He set up a door for his house, and he ruled over all his goods.
verses.22: He will not allow his sons to rule over him, nor will his elders wait for him.
verses.23: And Israel came out of Egypt, and Jacob lived in the land of the heathen.
verses.24: And he freed his people from their troubles, and saved them from their hardships.
verses.25: Their hearts became like those of a people who long to serve their master.
verses.26: Moses sent his servant Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.27: They placed their words and proverbs in the hot land.
verses.28: Send darkness, and it will be dark. Do not listen to his words.
verses.29: They turned their days into bloodshed, and their species became extinct.
verses.30: They scouted their lands in the palaces of their kings.
verses.31: And at evening, the clouds came upon all their borders.
verses.32: He gave them their lives as fuel for fire in their own land.
verses.33: And their branches and leaves withered, and the trees along their borders were destroyed.
verses.34: He said, “And Arbeh and Yelk came, and there were countless others.”
verses.35: And they ate every kind of plant in their land, and they ate the fruits of their own soil.
verses.36: And every tomb in their land was turned into a grave for all of them.
verses.37: And they were made of gold and silver; but their crowns did not have any decorations on them.
verses.38: The nations rejoiced when they departed, because their fear had been removed from them.
verses.39: He spread out the clouds for shelter, and fire to illuminate the night.
verses.40: He asked, and Shlomo brought bread from heaven to fill them.
verses.41: It opened a hole, and water flowed out. They walked along the channels of the river.
verses.42: For he remembers the sacred words of his servant Abraham.
verses.43: And he brought his people out of Egypt in a time of great suffering.
verses.44: And he gave them lands of other nations, and they became slaves to those nations.
verses.45: In order that their laws and ordinances may be preserved, let them be praised.
